environment.note: This freeze was created after all Mac-side implementation, testing, and validation was complete.

P0_01.issue: EXP-013 marked READY_FOR_LINUX with unimplemented RIFT-ONE-SHOT
P0_01.resolution: ABLATION_REGISTRY updated to IMPLEMENTED; EXP-013 notes updated

P0_02.issue: H3 has only n=1 multi-cause scenario — Wilcoxon undefined
P0_02.resolution: Development set expanded: +11 MULTI_CAUSE (MC_02-MC_12) + 3 AMBIGUOUS_ATTRIBUTION (AA_01-AA_03). n=15 for EXP-013 filter. Power ≈64%.

P0_03.issue: H2 power requirement not met (24 confounded, need 48)
P0_03.resolution: Total confounded = 48 across all splits (development=24, validation=24). EXP-002 pre-registers combined use for H2. Power target met.

P0_04.issue: RIFT-RANDOM run() hardcodes total_intervention_ed_s=0.0; RandomMSIS never called
P0_04.resolution: rift_random.py rewritten: run() calls self._random_msis.select(); total_intervention_ed_s = sum of selected intervention ed_s

P0_05.issue: No paper checklist enforcing synthetic-only labeling
P0_05.resolution: docs/PAPER_SUBMISSION_CHECKLIST.md created with mandatory sign-off procedure

P1_03.issue: H2 mapped to EXP-009 (wrong); H5 mapped to EXP-011 (wrong)
P1_03.resolution: hypotheses.md corrected: H2 → EXP-002+EXP-005; H5 → DEFERRED (no experiment)

P1_09.issue: EXP-014 uses non-standard statistical_test_cost / statistical_test_accuracy keys
P1_09.resolution: REGISTRY.yaml EXP-014 updated to use statistical_tests: {cost: ..., accuracy: ...}

P1_10.issue: H5 has no registered experiment; listed as DEFERRED without fallback
P1_10.resolution: hypotheses.md explicitly marks H5 as DEFERRED/future work; not in tested hypotheses list

P1_11.issue: R3 criterion fails for leaf-node services (payment, redis_cart, etc.)
P1_11.resolution: ebd.py _check_r3() extended with R3-leaf fallback: accepts upstream caller divergence for leaf nodes. Temporal safety constraint prevents false positives when upstream diverges before leaf.

P1_12.issue: Bayesian posterior update parameters (A_POS/B_POS/A_NEG/B_NEG) not documented
P1_12.resolution: closed_loop.py ClosedLoop class: comprehensive provenance comment added explaining prior causal reasoning for Beta(3,1)/Beta(1,3) choice and tuning policy

P2_02.issue: abstention_rate not computed same way across baselines
P2_02.resolution: BaselineOutput.__init__ now has abstention_reason: Optional[str] field. All abstention reason codes documented in class docstring.

P2_07.issue: BH FDR exploratory tests not pre-registered
P2_07.resolution: docs/EXPLORATORY_COMPARISONS_REGISTRY.md created: 7 pre-registered exploratory comparisons + prohibited post-hoc list

P2_08.issue: binomial_one_sided() p_null=0.70 default wrong when in-dist P@1 < 1.0
P2_08.resolution: stats.py: docstring updated with explicit warning and caller computation requirement

P2_09.issue: No cross-references between claims_registry and paper sections
P2_09.resolution: CLAIMS_REGISTRY.yaml: paper_section: DRAFT added to all 13 claims
